name: cadherin 4

function.text: CDH4 encodes cadherin-4. Annotated molecular activities include beta-catenin binding and cadherin binding. It participates in cell adhesion and cell migration.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
